title: Pre-pilot learner privacy safeguards

preflight.note: Separated from WI312 before any new learner collection or controlled pilot; implementation is not started.

acceptance_criteria.text: Publish a pre-pilot data boundary stating that learner state remains local by default, participation does not authorize telemetry, cloud upload, marketing, model training, or publication, and any sharing is voluntary and purpose-limited.

Define the pilot feedback and support workflow using pseudonymous identifiers where practical; prohibit real learner data, notes, scores, credentials, sensitive screenshots, and unredacted diagnostics in public issues, fixtures, CI logs, and RepoPact evidence.

Document participant notice and consent, data minimization, access and withdrawal, retention and deletion, support contact, and stop conditions before recruitment; collect no birth dates or unrelated identifiers for convenience.

Set a clear boundary for minors and institution-controlled pilots: pause collection or recruitment that changes the general-audience local-use assumptions until the actual deployment, data flows, and required controls receive qualified review; make no COPPA, FERPA, GDPR, CCPA, or other compliance claim without substantiated facts and controls.
Review the WI310 pilot runbook against these safeguards, record any required changes, and complete a public-safe evidence and privacy scan before WI228 is activated.

source: WI312 dependency audit found its pilot-related privacy protections were sequenced after WI228; split required pre-pilot controls into a separate gate.
